summary: Rubico Inc., a Greek-domiciled Nasdaq-listed shipping owner, filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release dated September 17, 2026, announcing a stock dividend of 0.50 common shares per outstanding share. Record date is September 28, 2026, distribution on or about October 5, 2026, with Nasdaq due-bill trading and dividend-adjusted trading from about October 6, 2026. Fractional shares are cash-settled using the record-date Nasdaq close. Warrant exercise prices fall 33.33% and warrant share counts rise 50% immediately after the record date. No board advisor, premium, or cash consideration is stated.
